(a) Identify the structure pinned green
(b) What is the embryological origin of the part pinned "A"?

marker.description: Green-headed pins indicating specific structures on the kidney

main_explanation: The pin at the lower pole of the kidney indicates the ureter, which drains the renal pelvis.

supporting_question.question: What is the embryological origin of the ureter?
supporting_question.explanation: The ureter develops from the ureteric bud, which is an outgrowth of the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct.
